fullSource:
use default

has_extension(name: string, extensions: string[]) -> bool =>
    extensions |> any(ext =>
        name.to_lower().ends_with(".{ext.to_lower()}"))

let extensions =
    ["zip", "rar", "7z", "gz", "archive", "A##", "tar.bz2"]

let names = [
    "MyData.a##", "MyData.tar.Gz", "MyData.gzip",
    "MyData.7z.backup", "MyData...", "MyData",
    "MyData_v1.0.tar.bz2", "MyData_v1.0.bz2"
]

for name in names do
    write_line("{name}: {has_extension(name, extensions)}")
od
output:
MyData.a##: True
MyData.tar.Gz: True
MyData.gzip: False
MyData.7z.backup: False
MyData...: False
MyData: False
MyData_v1.0.tar.bz2: True
MyData_v1.0.bz2: False
